The device, featuring CH32V307 and ESP32-C2 chips, enables control of Windows 64-bit PCs via web or WeChat interfaces using MQTT. It supports wake, sleep, restart, and shutdown commands, relying on USB for direct wake and local networking for others. Key limitations include the lack of Linux/macOS support and reliance on host-side BIOS settings for wake-from-shutdown.

title: 月薪8万招人，一群FDE却接不到单｜风向
content: Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs) command high salaries, yet many struggle to secure work. While tech giants and startups aggressively recruit for these AI-focused roles, independent FDEs face significant hurdles in client acquisition and project delivery. Success requires strong communication skills and the ability to translate business needs into working systems. The role involves on-site problem-solving, with significant variance in pay based on project scale and location. Despite high demand for AI implementation, FDEs must overcome challenges in defining scope, managing expectations, and ensuring sustainable system deployment, often bearing personal financial risks.

title: GPT-6.2 Astra要来了，神秘「双模型」闪现API，OpenAI火速撤回
content: OpenAI briefly listed two candidate models, rc-ada-or-vm and rc-ada-sh-vm, in its API before immediately retracting them. These models utilize a dual-VM architecture: one for global task orchestration and another for sandboxed execution. Simultaneously, a hardware engineering blog revealed an unreleased internal model that outperforms the current GPT-6 Astra on the BenchCAD 2.0 benchmark, achieving a peak score of 87.5% compared to Astra’s 59.4%. This internal model likely serves as the foundation for upcoming GPT-6.2 releases, specifically GPT-6.2 Astra and a larger "Betelgeuse" model.

content: Bloomberg reports that Binance likely cannot obtain insurance payouts for its $6.3 billion crypto asset theft because it lacks specific cyberattack coverage. While the exchange maintains director and officer liability insurance for related regulatory investigations or lawsuits, it does not hold policies for cyberattack losses. This highlights a broader issue where cryptocurrency firms struggle to secure adequate cybersecurity insurance, and existing policy exclusions often limit compensation. Additionally, analysis indicates Binance’s fines and theft losses over the past five years totaled $10.7 billion, representing 56% of its pre-tax profits.

content: Italy’s hastily implemented exit tax, widely criticized by experts, combines high tax rates with limited exemptions, making it burdensome for both departing residents and the country’s tax base. Unlike better-designed regimes in other jurisdictions, it lacks flexibility to account for unrealized capital gains, potentially accelerating capital flight. Critics argue the policy’s flawed structure and poor timing undermine its effectiveness, creating administrative complexity without yielding the expected revenue, thus damaging Italy’s appeal to wealthy individuals and international investors.

title: Arnis turns any place on Earth into a Minecraft world
content: Arnis is an open-source project by Louis Erbkamm that converts real-world data from OpenStreetMap into explorable Minecraft worlds. Started in 2022, it has reached 900,000 downloads and 70 contributors. A community-driven initiative, Arnis integrates geospatial details like elevation and street furniture, using 3D models for complex structures. Erbkamm maintains the project, leveraging GitHub Copilot for code reviews, regression testing, and documentation. The tool supports education by allowing schools to generate local environments for interactive learning. Recent updates expanded generation capabilities to include the Moon and Mars.
